items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I did some thing for Bernie Green.

ctx.x: So that was about a year, you said.

That was over a year. About a year
and two months. I did a couple of things while I was there.
I did some thing for Bernie Green. Do you know Bernie Green?

I know his name very well, from back
in radio days.
